title: messageId described as ULID — implementation detail leaking into spec
description: §5.2 defines messageId as 'The receiver-assigned ULID of the new message.' ULID is an implementation choice, not a normative constraint. The field should be defined as 'the id of the message as assigned by the server' and leave the ID format to JMAP-CHAT.
close_reason: Removed ULID; now reads 'Message.id in JMAP-CHAT'
